packageRules.description: GitHub Actions: let Dependabot own these (see .github/dependabot.yml) to avoid duplicate PRs. Renovate ignores the ecosystem.
Node (server.js) -- only matters if you opt into the optional Node backend. Group minor/patch, keep majors separate.
Python tooling (PyYAML, etc.) -- opt in if you add a requirements.txt. Disabled while the project is stdlib-only.
